subject.title: Oceanside Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 1

text: As a retired Navy Lieutenant Commander, I bring 25 years of disciplined military leadership and 14 years of public service to our community. I have served in demanding administrative, educational, operational and strategic roles, to great success.

Our leadership must prioritize academic achievement, given our poor test scores. It is time for a change. Let’s get back to the basics: teaching students to read, write, master mathematics, and think critically.

As a teacher holding Master’s degrees in Global Leadership and Postsecondary Education, I understand what academic success requires. Working inside Oceanside Unified has given me firsthand insight into our institutional challenges.

We must demand strict fiscal transparency. Record per-student spending must reach classrooms to provide the essential tools, personnel, and support needed to restore value and respect for our teachers and improve student outcomes.

Throughout my career, I have proven my ability to tackle tough challenges and put service before self. I am ready to bring my military discipline, educational expertise, and district experience to the school board to fight for our families and community.
I respectfully ask for your vote to bring accountability back to our schools. Let’s get to work!
Please visit jerrygarcia4ousd.com or call me (442) 238-1660.

text: I have served as a school counselor in our community for the past 11 years and as a school board trustee for the past four years. I have seen the challenges students, families and schools currently face and the needs of our community.

I am passionate about public education because it can open doors of possibilities to all students regardless of their background. My experience also includes working for college access programs, after -school programs, and continuation schools. My diverse experience in education and connection to our community allow me to bring a unique perspective to the table when making decisions.

During my time as a school board member, I have continued to advocate for rigorous educational programs to prepare students for a successful future, mental health services, and maintaining a fiscally solved budget.

If re-elected, I will continue to foster positive relationships with all stakeholders to ensure our students have equitable opportunities to succeed and our schools have the resources necessary to provide a safe, supportive, and engaging place where every student can learn, succeed, and pursue their passions.
I respecfully ask for your vote.
